item.title: Special Edition — Microsoft’s AI Bet Finally Showed the Revenue
item.description: Microsoft’s fiscal fourth quarter delivered a clear beat, Azure reaccelerated to 43%, and first-quarter guidance pointed higher—evidence that enormous AI infrastructure spending is converting into cloud revenue.
